prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production component for handcrafted papercraft miniature cinema. Exquisite fine natural paper fibers and very soft uneven warm cream watercolor wash; subtle evidence of a real cut edge and thickness: narrow darker kraft edge at bottom/right, tiny handmade irregularities at corners, two small foldable mounting tabs projecting from lower edge. No room, no furniture, no objects, no scene, no illustration printed on paper, no patterns, no words, no ruled lines, no black border, no stickerwhiteoutline.
